moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Fissure
moves.description:
Ground (Physical)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 30
Priority: 0
Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's Stockpile count increases by 1. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 3. The user's Stockpile count is reset to 0 when it is no longer active.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Attack stat are used as normal.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 85
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

moves.name: Belly Drum
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.description:
Ground (Physical)
Base Power: 95
Accuracy: 95
Priority: 0
No additional effect.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description:
Rock (Physical)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Chople Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fighting-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Chesto Berry
items.description: Holder wakes up if it is asleep. Single use.

items.name: Expert Belt
items.description: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2x damage.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Lum Berry
items.description: Holder cures itself if it has a non-volatile status or is confused. Single use.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.description: If a Pokemon uses a Fire- or Ice-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Immunity
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.

abilities.name: Gluttony
abilities.description: When this Pokemon is holding a Berry that usually activates with 1/4 or less of its maximum HP, it is eaten at 1/2 or less of its maximum HP instead.
